home.title: Home
home.body: Your society's summary will show here.

noSociety.title: You are not part of a society yet
noSociety.body: Set up your society now, or ask your society admin to send you an invite link.

setup.title: Set up your society
setup.name: Society name
setup.dueDays: Payment due (days after the bill date)
setup.upiHelp: For the payment QR code on bills. Optional.
setup.bankLast4: Last 4 digits of the bank account
setup.bankLast4Help: Shown on bills. Never the full number.
setup.inviteLater: Add the people who run the society with you. You can also do this later.
setup.needContact: Add an email or phone number

invites.title: People and invites
invites.adminOnly: Only the society admin can add people and send invites.
invites.name: Name
invites.linkBody: Sending invites by email is coming soon. For now, copy each link and send it to the person. Each link works once.
invites.noFlats: Add flats first, then invite owners and tenants.
invites.needFlat: Choose the flat for this person

flats.title: Flats and members
flats.empty: No flats yet. The quickest way is to import them from Excel.
flats.invalidArea: Enter the area in square feet, for example 650
flats.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in rupees, for example 960000

fields.flatTypeHelp: For example 1BHK. Shown only; not used for charges.
fields.costHelp: Architect-certified cost of the flat. Used for sinking and repair funds.

members.title: People in this flat
members.endQuestion: Mark {{name}} as moved out today? Their past records stay.

wings.title: Wings and lifts
wings.body: Lift charges are shared only by flats in wings that have a lift.
wings.name: Wing name
wings.nameHelp: For example A, B or Tower 1

import.title: Import flats from Excel
import.body: Add all flats, owners, tenants and opening balances at once. Nothing is saved until you check and confirm.
import.step1Body: Fill one row per flat. The second sheet explains each column.
import.step2Body: We check every row and show you what we found.
import.confirmQuestion: Import {{count}} flats now? {{skipped}} rows that need fixing will be skipped.
import.skipped: {{count}} rows were skipped. Fix them in the file and import again.

issues.tooManyDecimals: {{field}} has more than 2 digits after the point.
issues.invalidEmail: {{field}} is not a valid email address.
issues.duplicateInFile: The same flat is also in row {{otherRow}}.
issues.alreadyExists: This flat is already in SocietyIQ.
issues.liftConflict: Wing {{wing}} has a different lift answer in row {{otherRow}}.
issues.liftDiffers: Wing {{wing}} is saved with a different lift answer; the import will not change it.
issues.tenantPhoneNoName: Tenant phone is given but tenant name is empty.
issues.carpetMissing: Carpet area is empty; it is needed for some charges.
issues.costMissing: Construction cost is empty; it is needed for sinking and repair funds.
issues.letOutNoTenant: The flat is let out but no tenant is given.
